title: SWF compile: ShapeDisplayObject blendMode lost in posChanged branch and missing from colorEffectKey
description:
Two related gaps left unfixed by task 0988:

Bug A — posChanged branch (compile.ts):
In the main-timeline compile loop, the posChanged branch for shapes (lines ~2186-2253) handles filters and alpha but never checks blendMode. When a ShapeDisplayObject with a non-normal blend mode changes position/scale/rotation, the code falls through to encodePlaceObject2Move, emitting PlaceObject2 which cannot carry blend mode. The blend mode is silently dropped for all subsequent frames after the first.
Compare: the instance posChanged path at line ~2353 correctly checks hasBlend and emits PlaceObject3 — the same pattern is missing for shapes.

Bug B — colorEffectKey (compile.ts):
colorEffectKey() for shape type only tracks alpha (lines ~907-912). It does not include blendMode or filters. This means a shape that ONLY changes blend mode across frames (without a position change) will NOT set posChanged = true, so the new blend mode is never re-emitted. The first frame's blend mode stays encoded permanently.

Bug C — sprite.ts posChanged shape path:
The sprite.ts posChanged branch for shapes (lines ~419-435) has the same gap: only visible === false and filters are checked; blendMode is missing. The fix from task 1110 covered bitmap and instance in sprite.ts but not shape.

Fix:
1. In colorEffectKey() for shape type, also include blendMode in the returned key — e.g. blend:${shp.blendMode} when set and non-normal.
2. In compile.ts posChanged shape branch, add a hasBlend check mirroring the instance path and emit encodePlaceObject3WithBlendMode(..., true) (move=true).
3. In sprite.ts posChanged shape branch (after the filters check), add the same hasBlend check.

Files: packages/swf/src/compile.ts, packages/swf/src/sprite.ts
